questions.stem: To which school did the two great friends go?
questions.answer: The two friends went to Mushanga Primary School.

questions.stem: Why wasn’t there lunch for Lolo and Jemba in this school?
questions.answer: There was no lunch because parents had to contribute towards their children’s feeding.

questions.stem: What could Lolo do with the money that his parents sometimes gave him?
questions.answer: Lolo could buy pancakes and buns and some juice for lunch.

questions.stem: Why did Jemba ride at a very high speed?
questions.answer: Jemba rode at a very high speed because he was excited and wanted to enjoy the ride and still get back to school in time for the afternoon lessons.

questions.stem: Why did Jemba ring the bicycle bell as he sped up?
questions.answer: Jemba rang the bicycle bell to warn the old man who was in front of him.

questions.stem: What led to the accident, according to the passage?
questions.answer: The accident happened because Jemba lost his balance and both he and the old man fell off the bicycle.

questions.stem: What did the head teacher do immediately she arrived at the clinic?
questions.answer: Immediately she arrived at the clinic, the head teacher thanked the nurses for treating the boys.

questions.stem: For how long did the two friends stay away from school?
questions.answer: The two friends stayed away from school for three weeks.

questions.stem: Why did the academic performance of the pupils in this school greatly improve?
questions.answer: The academic performance greatly improved because all pupils started having lunch at school.
